case.title: Registry says approved, risk service says expired

decision.recommendation: This request requires manual review due to conflicting vendor security status, an expired security assessment, and potential overlap with an existing company-wide license for SignalWatch.

evidence.finding: Required approvals: Department Head, Procurement, Finance, Security
Existing approved license for SignalWatch (SW005) available to Engineering
Vendor security review status is expired (last review 2025-07-01)
Registry shows security status as 'Approved' (2025-07-01), conflicting with vendor-risk service
Request is within the remaining Engineering software budget
Approval tier $10,000.01 - $25,000: $24,000.00 is between $10,000.01 and $25,000 -> minimum approvals Department Head, Finance, Procurement
Vendor-risk service: status 'expired', last review 2025-07-01, risk medium, personal data=False, outside region=False; registry: 'Approved' (2025-07-01), new vendor=False, legal terms 'Approved'
Registry says 'Approved' (2025-07-01) but vendor-risk service says 'expired' (2025-07-01) - conflict must be resolved by Security, not silently
Security review required: Data access level 'production_telemetry' (production data access)
Security review required: Integration 'Production cloud account' (production integration)
Security review required: Vendor security assessment is not current (status 'expired', review date 2025-07-01)
Security review required: Registry and vendor-risk service disagree
Existing approved software overlaps: SignalWatch (Observability, 80 seats, scope Engineering)

decision.next_step: Route to Security for resolution of the conflicting vendor status and assessment of whether the existing SignalWatch license can accommodate the 'Advanced' features requested.

raw_llm_decision.rationale: The request involves production data access and integration, triggering a mandatory security review. Furthermore, the vendor's security status is expired and reported inconsistently across internal systems. Finally, the requester already has access to SignalWatch, so it must be determined if the 'Advanced' tier is a necessary upgrade or if existing capacity can be utilized.
